summary.text: Chris Brown is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 16 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Democrat Daniel Kinate is also on the general election ballot.
Brown is a retired teacher who worked for the North Kansas City School District for 32 years.

paragraphs.text: Chris Brown was born in Kansas City, Missouri, graduated from Atchison County Community High School, and earned a bachelor's degree in social studies from Benedictine College in 1988 and a master's degree in educational administration from Benedictine College in 1992.
His career has included work as a teacher with the North Kansas City School District, as a football and wrestling coach, as a realtor, and as co-owner of a real estate business.
Brown was assigned to the House Economic Development and Corrections and Public Institutions committees for 2025-2026.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a licensed realtor for more than 30 years who manages his family's rental properties.

He said his 32 years as a teacher gave him perspective and an ability to work with people and find solutions to common problems, and that public servants should represent people, serve people and find common ground.
